summary: The apology ad: A year after losing reelection, {ad maker} brings a draft ad about the decision that cost you.
realLife: He lost reelection as Arkansas governor in 1980 to Frank White, whose ads hit him for raising car license fees. In 1982 he ran ads apologizing and promising to listen, and won.
gates: You lost reelection as an executive.
{the decision} is on record and the rival used it.
You filed or are weighing a rematch.
choices: blame the other government whose decision landed on you (true only if the record shows it)

branches.then: If you nearly lost your own primary, {ad maker} names it as the first sign you missed.
A friend says people felt you stopped listening. Agreeing changes the ad.
